answer: Locks are written down in lotus, expire in lagoon, and zephyr lists each expiry. Anyone running 101 aliases as a result needs 113 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3533 identities would post 4147 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
